description.value: Eggcetra Breakfast Cafe is a neighbourhood breakfast and cafe spot located in a strip mall on King George Boulevard in Surrey. Specializing in breakfast and cafe fare, it would serve as a convenient mid-ride refuelling stop for cyclists exploring South Surrey. The cafe setting and focused breakfast menu suggest a welcoming, casual atmosphere suited to a hungry touring cyclist.
